svg.title: Evolution moves tumors away from fermenting
svg.desc: Over 300 steps the tumor's average share of budget spent on mitochondria rises from 0.5 to about 0.9, and the share of glucose it ferments falls from about 0.9 to about 0.3. The neutral marker barely moves. Snapshots: the tumor is orange (fermenting) at step 40 and purple (respiring) at 300.
svg.text: neutral marker (chance alone) (shifted to start at 0.5)
